story.hook: My roommate started charging me couch fees.
story.script: He taped a handwritten price list beside the television and said sitting on the couch after dinner now cost five dollars because I was creating extra wear. I thought he was joking until he sent me a payment request for fifteen dollars and added a late fee the next morning. So I opened our lease, checked the furniture clause, and found the couch was actually mine because I had bought it before he moved in. I sent him the receipt and asked whether he wanted to keep renting my couch from me instead. The fee list disappeared before lunch.

youtube.title: My Roommate Started Charging Couch Fees #Shorts
